title: Surreal Cosmic Encounter
description: A surreal scene depicts a wooden bridge connecting a purple platform with a green skull wearing braided hair and red eyes to a yellow rock where an astronaut kneels. Multiple glowing green orbs containing human hands float throughout the psychedelic alien landscape under a swirling pink sky with a large turquoise planet.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic landscape featuring a wooden bridge between a purple platform holding a green skull with long black braided hair, red glowing eyes, and colorful beads, and a yellow rock where a kneeling astronaut in a white spacesuit rests. Multiple transparent green bubbles containing realistic human hands float in the air. The background shows an alien planet covered in yellow skull patterns, purple rock formations with orange foliage, and a swirling pink cosmic sky with a large glowing turquoise planet emitting light rays.
